about_the_game:
RELSU is a dynamic roguelite game. Team up with up to four friends or fight alone. Repel waves of enemies, battle powerful bosses, complete various quests, and improve your character with a unique skill tree for each one. Experience the thrill of this fast-paced action roguelite!

1-4 PLAYER CO-OP

Call your friends and team up to fight hundreds of monsters, complete random team challenges, and level up. Have fun together!

UNIQUE RANDOM TASKS

Complete each unique task and battle the Boss at the end!

MASTER YOUR SKILLS

Each RELSU has unique abilities that match their character style, as well as general abilities that suit all characters. Find the one that fits your play style!

UNIQUE MAPS

Fight on different game maps. Each one has a unique playing arena, ranging from simple to interesting shapes, with unique textures, designs, and color schemes.

JOIN OUR COMMUNITY ON DISCORD!

If you encounter an error, would like to leave other feedback, or just want to find people to talk to, you can do all this and much more on our Discord server! We also plan to publish content from this and our future games. Join us, we are waiting for you!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: (Intel): Core i5-2300 @ 2,80 GHz, (AMD): FX 8120 @ 3.1 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: (NVIDIA): GeForce® GT 730, (AMD): Radeon R7 240
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: (AMD): Ryzen 3 3300U, (Intel): i5-7300U 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: (NVIDIA): GeForce® GTX 960, (AMD): R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
